summary: Full backend + frontend testing of House of Chirmi marketing site. Backend: 12 pytest cases against the public preview URL (health, enquiry create+persist+newest-first, invalid email 422, blank name 422, honeypot no-store, gated GET 401 for missing/bad token, creator create+persist, creator honeypot, rate limit 6th=429) — all 12 passed. Frontend (prerendered production build): all 8 routes return 200 with SSR headings, bogus /work/does-not-exist redirects to /work, SPA nav works with aria-current='page' + scarlet seed marker, studio accordion (6 items) toggles aria-expanded and reveals answers, contact enquiry form submits (button shows 'Sending…' then exact success copy) and the record with need + budget persists (verified via gated GET), collective segmented tabs switch panels and creator form with category chips submits successfully, inline email validation shows 'Please enter a valid email so we can reply.' without hitting the API. No page/hydration errors on any real route; no third-party analytics in app code.

minor.issue: Rate limiter trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value, so a client can bypass the 5/IP/hr cap by spoofing the header (tests deliberately used this). Consider using the right-most trusted proxy hop.
Rate-limit buckets are shared across both endpoints and are in-memory only (reset on restart, not multi-worker safe). Acceptable for MVP, worth noting.
Sorting is on the ISO string field created_at (works, but no index); no pagination — to_list(1000) hard cap.

ui_bugs.issue: Accordion trigger buttons and panels have no data-testid; tests must fall back to '#questions button[aria-expanded]'. Recommend data-testid="faq-question-{i}" / "faq-panel-{i}" (not fixed here because frontend is a prebuilt production bundle requiring a rebuild).

Need chips use data-testid="need-chip-{opt}" (e.g. need-chip-Website) rather than the 'enquiry-need-*' naming in the test brief, and budget is a native <select data-testid="enquiry-budget"> not chips. Functionality is correct; just a naming/doc mismatch for future test scripts.

issues: React minified errors #418/#423 (hydration text mismatch) fire before the client-side redirect to /work, since the prerendered fallback HTML differs from the client render. Functionally harmless (redirect works) but noisy in console; a 404-aware prerender or a Navigate rendered before hydration content would remove it.
Large empty vertical gap between the hero paragraph and the next section at 1920x1080 (gradient fallback block renders as blank/paper-coloured space) — verify intended spacing.

action_items: Optional: harden rate limiting against X-Forwarded-For spoofing (use trusted-proxy hop) and consider separate buckets per endpoint.
Optional: add data-testid to Accordion question/panel elements for stable future test automation (needs frontend rebuild).
Optional: eliminate hydration mismatch (React #418/#423) on unknown /work/:slug routes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is compact and correct: _id excluded from gated GETs, Pydantic validation, honeypot returns 200 without storing, SMTP failure never loses the enquiry.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI — migrate to a lifespan handler.
Rate limit dict _hits grows unbounded (no eviction of stale IP keys) — minor memory leak over long uptime.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed enquiries/creators via API and UI; all removed afterwards from MongoDB (8 enquiries, 2 creators deleted). One pre-existing non-test enquiry left untouched.
test_credentials: Admin bearer: hoc_admin_7f4c1e9a2b6d48f0ab35c1d9e2f8a640 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — valid, gated GETs work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit is 5 posts/IP/hour shared by /api/enquiry and /api/creator. Backend tests send a unique X-Forwarded-For per request to avoid throttling; UI submissions from the browser count against the real client IP, so keep UI form submits to <=5/hr or expect 429. Correct testids: enquiry-name/email/brand/link/message/budget(select)/submit, need-chip-{Website|Brand partnership|Creator content|Not sure}, creator-name/handle/city/sample1/sample2/submit, creator-cat-{cat}, collective-tab-brands/creators, form-success. Accordion has no testid; use '#questions button[aria-expanded]'. Frontend is a prerendered production build (node serve.mjs), so code changes need a rebuild.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only console errors (React #418/#423) come from hydrating the prerendered fallback HTML on an unknown /work/:slug path before CaseDetail's client-side redirect to /work executes.
